properties.description: Core, on the in-memory backend: nodes written while recording are credited once each in write order; nothing is recorded unless a caller asked; taking the log stops recording; Snapshots and Contributors are never credited; a node gone by the end of the call is skipped; an unknown contributor is refused with nothing credited; crediting never makes someone an approver; an existing approval is kept when the same person is also credited as author.
properties.name: Every node written while recording is credited once as author, and nothing else is
